sentence: A non-drowsy antihistamine that blocks the effects of histamine to relieve allergy symptoms, including those of allergic rhinitis and long-lasting hives.

sentence: It can be bought from pharmacies and shops, drowsiness is its most common side effect, and a serious allergic reaction to it is rare but needs a 999 call.

sentence: Loratadine is an antihistamine that the NHS describes as non-drowsy and as relieving allergy symptoms.
In the UK its licensed uses, according to the summary of product characteristics, are the symptomatic treatment of allergic rhinitis and of chronic idiopathic urticaria.
Allergic rhinitis is the medical name for hay fever and similar allergies that affect the nose, and urticaria is the medical name for hives.
Chronic idiopathic urticaria means hives that last a long time without an identified cause.
note: Plain definition of the SmPC term.

note: NHS: 10mg tablets and liquid; brand name Clarityn.
